name: ETFS canonical-output + delta-charts -- DynamoDB daily rows + monthly 'marquis' (avg-accented) + 6 chart families + periodic deck
description: Andrew-direct (2026-06-25, given to 0.4.0_DE) -- the canonical-OUTPUT + analytics-charts layer ON TOP of the ETFS data pipeline (ETFS_SETUP producers + ETFS_AVGCAP metric + the daily-text-report presentation). Andrew decisions captured (DE spec docs/briefs/ETFS_canonical_output_and_charts_design_v0.1.md): (1) GRAIN = PARTNER-NOW / end-client-LATER -- phased, forward-compatible client_id+grain key (ships on the live partner-grain pipeline now, refines to per-household/per-client later WITHOUT a rewrite); (2) DAILY = a DynamoDB row (table opal-etfs-ownership-daily, PK client#etf / SK date + GSIs for the cuts), NO charts; (3) MONTHLY = the 'marquis' artifact -- AVERAGE-level client aggregates ACCENTED at top + current+average summary + daily-values-per-ETF-per-client matrix + DELTA CHARTS (period + available-lookback) at 3 cuts (per-ETF / per-client / per-client-ETF) = 6 chart families. Architecture: an internal fan-in Lambda off the existing S3 daily slices feeds the Dynamo table (firm-sep write-out intact); the monthly producer EXTENDS avgcap_monthly_average.py -> the canonical marquis artifact; the periodic deck (deck-gen) renders it. CONCURRENT WITH the daily-text-report (ETFS presentation core, deployed+CVO-certed) -- this is the richer canonical/charts layer, not a replacement.
